rescues.name: Matilda
rescues.family: Rescued with Orcca, Fabio, Paul, Hershey, Bob, Frankie, Flake, Bukkleh and Bettyboo
rescues.summary: Spayed, fully vaccinated and dewormed. A calm Persian girl, about 3 years old.
rescues.story:
Matilda belonged to a Ukrainian woman who had around 20 cats. When she was taken away by the police over her residency papers, her cats were left behind, and the building guard wanted to throw them all out on the street. Some of them were blind.

We rescued all of them at once, and Matilda was one of them. She came with Orcca, Fabio, Paul, Hershey, Bob, Frankie, Flake, Bukkleh and Bettyboo.

Today Matilda is about 3 years old, spayed, fully vaccinated and dewormed. She lives with other cats and is ready for a loving home of her own.

rescues.name: Vito
rescues.summary: Neutered and fully vaccinated. A very friendly boy.
rescues.story:
Vito and Finn were rescued together when they were small kittens. We don't know if they are brothers, because they don't look alike, but they were found side by side.

A girl gave them to a delivery driver to take to another girl. That girl stopped answering and sent him a location at a factory in Sahab. When he arrived, there was no food and no place for the cats, and nobody answered his calls. He took photos and reached out to a friend's husband, an engineer, who told his wife, and she told us.

When we took them in, they had diarrhea and fleas, their fur was badly matted, and they were starving. We treated them, neutered them and gave them all their vaccines.

Today Vito is healthy, very friendly, and gets along well with other cats.

rescues.name: Cessario
rescues.summary: A sweet, gentle boy who loves to eat and sleep. Neutered, fully vaccinated, dewormed and flea-treated.
rescues.story:
We rescued Cessario in Zarqa, a city far from Amman. It is a very poor, desert area where many people don't care for animals. He had been dumped near an abandoned factory, with no food at all.

He was only about 8 months old, starving and so thin he looked like a skeleton. You can see how he looked back then in his rescue video on our Instagram.

Today Cessario is under 2 years old, healthy and very sweet. He loves to eat and to sleep. He is neutered, fully vaccinated, and we always keep his deworming and flea treatment up to date.

rescues.name: Julie
rescues.summary: A sweet young girl who has been through a lot, now healthy and ready for a loving home.
rescues.story:
Julie was found thrown out on the street, pregnant and very thin. Her owners did not want her anymore. She was only about 7 months old when she was pregnant, and sadly she lost her babies.

We rescued her and helped her get strong again. Today Julie is under 2 years old, still young and gentle, and she lives with other cats at home.

She truly deserves a family who will love her and never let her go.

rescues.name: Cappy
rescues.summary: Fully vaccinated and neutered. Blind in one eye, and one of the sweetest cats you will ever meet.
rescues.story:
Cappy spent months living in a vegetable market, waiting for someone to take him home. A kind woman messaged us again and again on Instagram asking for help. When we finally saw her messages, his story broke our hearts, and we went to get him.

Cappy later got a hematoma in his ear. We did surgery to save it and bring it back to normal, and today his ear is doing great, with no problems at all.

He sees from one eye only, but it doesn't slow him down for a second. Cappy is one of the gentlest, cutest and most loving cats you could ever meet. One eye is no reason not to open your heart to him.

rescues.name: Labubu
rescues.condition: Congenital narrowing of the rectal opening
rescues.story:
We rescued Labubu together with her mom, Cocoley, and her brothers and sisters Bubbles, Pino and Doritto.

Labubu was born with a very narrow, tiny rectal opening, most likely a congenital problem, so she struggled to pass stool. The vets tried surgery, but it is a very difficult area to operate on. She kept suffering for a while, and sadly it didn't work out, and we lost her.

Her brothers and sisters are alive and doing great today. They are neutered, vaccinated and thriving. We will always remember our sweet Labubu.

rescues.name: Nina
rescues.summary: Fully vaccinated and spayed. Petite, short-legged and super friendly.
rescues.story:
Nina was only 5 months old when we found her, a kitten herself, and already pregnant. The early pregnancy caused her complications, so she had surgery and was spayed. She also had breathing problems, and we treated them.

Because her nose is a little short, she can sometimes breathe a bit harder, but overall she is a healthy, happy girl.

Nina is petite, with short little legs, and she is super friendly and so sweet with everyone she meets.

rescues.name: Lia
rescues.summary: A very friendly girl, spayed and fully vaccinated. Mom of Tia.
rescues.story:
We saw people throw Lia out of a car onto the highway in Zarqa while we were driving by, so we stopped and took her. She was covered in fleas and very weak, and she was pregnant.

Soon after, she gave birth to two kittens. Sadly one of them didn't make it, but her daughter survived, and we named her Tia.

Today Lia is about 2 years old, spayed, fully vaccinated and very friendly.

rescues.name: Katy
rescues.summary: Fully vaccinated and spayed. A gentle, fluffy mom who is happy living with other cats.
rescues.story:
When we rescued Katy, she was pregnant and had a burn on her belly. We treated the burn, and today only a light scar is left.

She gave birth soon after. We lost one of her babies when he was very small, and her son Teto is still with us.

Katy is the sweetest, most lovable girl. She is a fluffy cat who adores being petted, especially near her tail. Like all our cats, she lives with other cats and gets along with them just fine.

Katy truly deserves a beautiful home of her own.

rescues.name: Charlie
rescues.summary: Neutered, fully vaccinated and healthy. A special boy who loves to play and nap.
rescues.story:
We rescued Charlie in Zarqa, sitting in a mud puddle. He was very thin and very weak.

At first his liver readings were high, so he was on Royal Canin Hepatic food for a while, with fluids, check-ups and tests. Little by little he got better, and today his readings are back to normal and he is healthy.

Charlie is a very special boy. He loves to play and to sleep, and he is a little chubby, but in good health. His story started out sad, but thankfully everything is fine now.

rescues.name: Tooteh
rescues.summary: Spayed and fully vaccinated, with her vaccines kept up to date.
rescues.story:
I rescued Tooteh in 2022, when she was a tiny kitten near City Mall. She was skin and bones, and fungus had covered her whole body. Honestly, when I first saw her, I didn't think she would survive.

Tooteh was one of the cats I treated myself at home, without a clinic, with guidance from the house-call vet we work with. Slowly she healed and grew strong. Later she was spayed and vaccinated, and her vaccines are still kept up to date.

When I look at who she was and who she is now, I feel so proud. Tooteh lives with us.

rescues.name: Satchi
rescues.story:
Satchi had a congenital condition, and we never found out exactly what was behind it. From early on he wasn't growing. His brother Satch kept getting bigger, but Satchi stayed small.

Then, suddenly, he started to decline. We did everything we could for him, but sadly he passed away. We will always remember our little boy.

rescues.care_intro: Kai is paralyzed in his back legs, but he is a happy, playful kitten. He needs a little extra help every day: his bladder expressed, a high-fiber diet and a clean, soft space.
rescues.care_diet_note: Paralyzed cats often have slower digestion, so Kai eats a high-fiber veterinary diet that keeps his bowels moving easily. Always keep fresh water out, and change his food only with your vet.

Music is a little tabby kitten who lives with us at home.

He loves curling up in soft blankets by the window, and he sits so politely when he wants your attention.

Music is now looking for a loving home of his own.

rescues.name: Mateo
rescues.condition: Lost his ear after a hematoma, lost all his teeth
rescues.summary: A gentle senior boy. Neutered, vaccinated, dewormed and treated for fleas.
rescues.story:
Mateo is an older house cat who was thrown out by his owners. For years he lived on the street outside a pharmacy, where people gave him milk to drink. When we spotted him, we shared his story, and together with a friend we took him in and got him treated.

His teeth were all broken and damaged, and he lost every one of them. Recently he developed a hematoma in his ear and needed surgery, and sadly he lost the ear.

Mateo is a very sweet and gentle soul. At his age, after everything he has been through, he could never go back to life on the street. We still cannot understand how anyone could abandon him.

rescues.name: Tavi
rescues.summary: Fully vaccinated, neutered and microchipped. His travel papers are ready and he is ready to fly to Switzerland.
rescues.story:
Tavi was thrown away in a black garbage bag together with his things and left in a dumpster. He was lying in his own mess with rotten food around him, and the bag was tied shut. Someone had even cut his whiskers. If we had found him any later, he would not have survived.

We rescued Tavi when he was a kitten, and he has grown into a gentle, beautiful boy.

Today he is about 2 years old, fully vaccinated, neutered and microchipped, and all his travel papers are ready. He can fly to Switzerland any time.

We hope Tavi finds his forever home there and enjoys every day of his new life.

rescues.name: Butterscotch
rescues.summary: Fully vaccinated and neutered. A panleukopenia survivor.
rescues.story:
Butterscotch came to us as a tiny, very frightened kitten. His brothers and sisters were sick too, and we treated all of them, but panleukopenia took them one by one. He held on so tight to his brother, and in the end he lost him to the virus as well.

Butterscotch was the lucky one. He fought the virus and won, and today he is healthy, strong and doing really well.

He is fully vaccinated and neutered, his travel papers are done, and very soon he flies to his new family in Milan, Italy.

rescues.name: Mia
rescues.summary: A gentle calico girl, soon flying to her new home in Milan, Italy.

rescues.name: Dino
rescues.summary: A gentle grey and white boy, fully vaccinated and microchipped, soon flying to his new home in Milan, Italy.
rescues.story:
We found Dino on the street with his sister. Sadly, she was poisoned right in front of him, and we could not save her.

We rescued Dino and brought him somewhere safe and warm. His story is a sad one, but he is growing into a sweet, curious boy.

Dino has all his vaccines and his microchip. He will be neutered before he travels.

Soon Dino will fly to his new family in Milan, Italy, to start a happy new chapter.

rescues.name: Nonose
rescues.condition: Lost his nose after an untreated injury, missing some teeth
rescues.summary: A very sweet, friendly boy with no nose. Not vaccinated yet.
rescues.story:
No Nose was dumped in Khalda, near a school. Three different people told us about him. The first time, by the time we asked where he was, he had disappeared. A second woman found him in the same area, and while we were sending a taxi to pick him up, he vanished again. The third time, a friend of ours found him, and we finally got him to the clinic.

The vet told us he had been hit, which tore his nose. With no treatment, infections slowly ate away at it over time. He had surgery to remove the dead part of his nose, and the broken teeth in his upper jaw were removed too.

So now he has no nose, but he lives a completely normal life. He eats wet and dry food, and he is very sweet and very friendly. No Nose lives with us now.

rescues.name: Oldie
rescues.summary: A very gentle boy who fully recovered from leishmaniasis. Neutered, vaccinated, dewormed and flea-treated.
rescues.story:
Oldie had leishmaniasis when he came to us. We treated him with medicine brought in from Italy, and a local pharmacy kindly helped us get it, thank you so much. In the future we will also reach out to the manufacturer directly, so we can keep learning how to best treat cases like his.

After his treatment we ran several tests and made sure he is 100% recovered. He has not shown any symptoms since, and he also completed a quarantine period. His latest leishmaniasis test came back negative, and he is now completely recovered. It makes us so happy to see him healthy and strong again.

We handle diseases like this very professionally, together with Dr. Ludmila, a Ukrainian vet well known in Jordan with 30 years of experience in this field.

Oldie is about 3 years old and lost one of his eyes, but he is very gentle and sweet. He is neutered, fully vaccinated, dewormed and flea-treated. We really hope he finds a loving home.

rescues.name: Mark
rescues.summary: A gentle, sweet tripod boy. Neutered, fully vaccinated and dewormed, hoping for a home abroad.
rescues.story:
For 29 days, Mark was lying on the street and nobody helped him. Only one man came by to feed him, and Mark had to drag himself along the ground.

Someone had shot him with a pump-action gun. The bullet went deep into his thigh bone and broke it. We did everything we could to save his leg, but sadly we couldn't.

Today Mark is a tripod dog, and he walks just fine on three legs. He is very gentle and sweet, and his colors are so unusual and lovely.

Mark is neutered, fully vaccinated and dewormed. We hope to find him a loving home abroad.
